name: Riso
summary: A risograph zine: two spot inks (federal blue and orange) on cream stock, overprint where they cross, a hard misregistered second pass on titles, halftone dots.
lineage: Risograph printing as used by independent publishers and zine makers (Riso Kagaku duplicators; studios such as Colorama and Hato Press).

motion.grammar: pass: the second ink lands; elements drop from a 6px offset into register, .45 s with a slight overshoot

frame: a page number at the bottom center, like a stapled zine
